notes:
What's new in 3.6.3:
- Usage tracking now covers everything the app generates. Until now only script breakdowns and final frames were recorded, so generating assets, a moodboard or a preview left no trace at all - someone could work in the app for an hour and show up as completely inactive in the stats.
- Cost estimates now follow the actual frame size and quality instead of a flat number per image, so a 4K moodboard is no longer counted the same as a small preview.
